spanish: Estos los impuros a ustedes en todo lo que pulula; todo el tocante en ellos en su muerte se impurecerá hasta la tarde.

findings.issue: הַשָּׁרֶץ is a definite singular noun; "lo que pulula" recasts it as a finite relative clause.
הָעָרֶב is the evening; "la tarde" in current Latin American Spanish more readily denotes the afternoon.

notes: Person, number, and the repeated כָּל are preserved; ustedes matches the 2mp suffix.
